HTTP compression.question: At a lower level, a _____-Encoding header field may indicate the payload of an HTTP message is compressed

HTTP compression.subject: Computer & IT
HTTP compression.question: At a higher level, a _____-Encoding header field may indicate that a resource being transferred, cached, or otherwise referenced is compressed
HTTP compression.fact: At a higher level, a Content-Encoding header field may indicate that a resource being transferred, cached, or otherwise referenced is compressed. HTTP compression.subject: Computer & IT
HTTP compression.question: Compression using _____-Encoding is more widely supported than Transfer-Encoding, and some browsers do not advertise support for Transfer-Encoding compression to avoid triggering bugs in servers
HTTP compression.fact: At a higher level, a Content-Encoding header field may indicate that a resource being transferred, cached, or otherwise referenced is compressed.
